Assess the consistency of shipment descriptions, product codes, quantities, declared values, and country-of-origin information. Review electronic records relating to goods entering, leaving, and moving within free trade zones. Reconcile inventory records against shipment documents, warehouse reports, and transaction histories. Identify discrepancies in customs documentation, inventory balances, shipment references, and declared transaction details. Monitor documentation requirements for temporary admission, bonded storage, re-export, and other applicable free zone procedures. Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and internal teams to resolve missing or inconsistent records. Review supporting documents for duty, tax, fee, and service-charge reconciliation. Maintain digital documentation registers, transaction logs, audit trails, and compliance records. Support internal audits and compliance reviews by organizing relevant trade and inventory documentation. Monitor changes in free zone procedures, customs documentation requirements, and international trade regulations. Prepare transaction summaries, discrepancy reports, compliance observations, and management updates. Recommend improvements to document control, recordkeeping, and electronic workflow processes. Maintain confidentiality and ensure accurate handling of commercial, financial, and shipment information. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree or diploma in logistics, supply chain management, international trade, customs administration, business administration, or a related discipline. Extensive experience in free trade zone documentation, customs coordination, freight forwarding, import/export administration, or trade compliance. Strong understanding of free zone operations, bonded inventory procedures, re-export processes, and international shipping documentation. Experience reviewing commercial invoices, packing lists, transport documents, customs records, and inventory movement reports. Familiarity with customs procedures, tariff classifications, origin documentation, and applicable trade regulations. Knowledge of electronic customs platforms, warehouse management systems, ERP systems, and document management tools. Strong reconciliation, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and digital reporting applications. Excellent written communication and stakeholder coordination abilities. High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple documentation workflows independently. Ability to work effectively with international teams in a fully remote environment. What We Offer 100% remote working arrangement from home. Full-time professional opportunity with senior-level responsibilities. Competitive compensation based on qualifications and relevant experience. Exposure to international trade, customs documentation, and free zone logistics operations. Opportunities for continuous professional development in trade compliance and supply chain administration. Collaborative working environment involving logistics, finance, customs, and compliance professionals. Flexible remote coordination across relevant business time zones, subject to operational requirements. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting their experience in free trade zone documentation, customs coordination, import/export administration, inventory reconciliation, and international trade compliance. Application Subject: Application – Senior Free Trade Zone Documentation Specialist (UAE Remote) Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. Important Scope Note: This is a fully remote documentation review, transaction reconciliation, and compliance coordination role. Physical cargo inspections, warehouse operations, goods handling, customs examinations, inventory counts, and on-site shipment verification must be performed by qualified local personnel.
